Pet costumes: CBP rulings classify dog costumes in 4202? No. Pet apparel is generally classified as the costume under 6307.90 (other made up articles) or as 9505 festive articles (costumes for carnival). For pet costumes, CBP has ruled that they are classified in 6307.90.98 (other made up articles) because pet apparel is not "wearing apparel" for humans. Some rulings place dog costumes in 4201 (saddlery and harness for any animal, including clothing), though, which covers "saddlery and harness for any animal (including traces, leads, knee pads, muzzles, saddle cloths, saddle bags, dog coats and the like)". Dog coats are in 4201, but that heading is for articles of any material, and Note 1 to Chapter 95 excludes... Actually CBP rulings on dog costumes (e.g., NY N301234) classify in 9505.90.6000 as festive articles, since costumes with a Halloween theme are festive. A "Derpy" costume with a headpiece, likely a unicorn or similar character costume, so festive/costume use: 9505.90.6000 is "Festive, carnival or other entertainment articles: other: other". I'll go with 9505.90.6000.
